clearedSpotChecks.check: Karst on Celo assumed shipped within six months: the EIP-7825 per transaction gas cap of 16,777,216 against the PoolManager paths other users need to leave a pool.
clearedSpotChecks.note: src/libraries/Pool.sol:145-204 updates two ticks, flips at most two bitmap words, updates one position and clears at most two ticks, with no loop. A grep of src/*.sol and src/libraries/*.sol for loops finds only the swap loop at src/libraries/Pool.sol:344, which the swapper bounds with sqrtPriceLimitX96 (Pool.sol:325-338). An attacker who adds many initialized ticks can raise the gas of a long swap, which the swapper splits, but cannot raise the gas of a removal or a take. The celo-kona main configs.json I fetched is byte-identical to the work copy, has jovian_time 1774958788 for the Celo mainnet entry and contains no karst key.
